about: The Journal's labels (what kind of piece it is) and topics (the five sections of the magazine). The one source for both: the build, the pages, the feeds and the choices in .pages.yml all follow this file (tests/content.test.ts checks .pages.yml). The labels are geometer.dev's six, unchanged. The topics are the five sections the owner set on 14 Nov 2026 (art, philosophy, civic ideas and technology blended); migration/map.json says where geometer.dev's old topics went. Each topic names its mascot (a face from src/characters/cast.ts and the mood it shows) and may carry a header picture (image: src, alt, credit, creditUrl) once the owner supplies one (docs/image-prompts.md).

labels.name: Idea
labels.gloss: A proposal. Nobody has tried it yet.

labels.name: Practical guide
labels.gloss: How to do one thing, step by step.

labels.name: Experiment
labels.gloss: A small test: what we ran and what we saw.

labels.name: Field report
labels.gloss: What happened in a real shop or group, with dates.

labels.name: Research
labels.gloss: Careful study, with its sources and its limits.

labels.name: Opinion
labels.gloss: A view we hold. You are welcome to disagree.

topics.name: Technology
topics.gloss: Tools, machines and intelligence that a place can own and run itself.

topics.name: Livelihoods
topics.gloss: Work and commerce: shops, trades, services and the money that stays where it is made.

topics.name: Community and civic life
topics.gloss: How a village, a town or a ward shares, decides and looks after things together.

topics.name: Ideas and philosophy
topics.gloss: Questions about technology and everyday life, thought through slowly.

topics.name: Art and culture
topics.gloss: Pictures, songs, crafts and stories, and the everyday life around them.
